## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.0-beta.11 recovers safely when a background code-graph refresh is interrupted, so agents can get back to current, scoped code context without manual cleanup.

Threadnote 5 helps agents begin with focused, cited code context. This beta makes background graph maintenance more resilient when work is cancelled or a workspace changes while a refresh is underway.

### Keep code context moving after an interrupted refresh

If a code-graph refresh stops before it finishes, Threadnote now recognizes the abandoned work and schedules the next refresh cleanly. Agents can continue from ready scoped context while Threadnote restores a current view in the background.

The recovery preserves the project boundary already selected, so refreshed results remain focused on the code the agent asked to inspect.
